profile.noLiveInOwner: Owner must not live in the flat
profile.destinationsHelp: Travel time to each one is computed for every listing. Leave the limit empty for no limit.
profile.zonesHelp: Pick from the neighbourhoods and towns of your listings, or type a name.
search.title: Search
search.browserNote: A browser window will open. Leave it visible: that's what keeps the portals from blocking the search.
search.captcha: A portal is showing a captcha. Solve it in the browser window; the search waits 90 seconds.
search.done: Done. {new} new listings, {accepted} that fit, {possible} to ask about.
profile.fixErrors: Some fields need fixing. Nothing was saved.
map.title: Map of your listings
map.help: Blue dots are your best matches. Black dots are your places.
listing.travelSource.graph: Times estimated from the metro network.
profile.pickHelp: Press "Place on map" on a place, then click the map to move it there.
profile.realTravelTimes: Listings to check with real timetables
travel.title: Travel times
travel.graphHelp: Free and works offline. Metro, FGC and Rodalies with average times; no buses.
travel.transitousHelp: Free real timetables, buses included. One request per place, from the public server or your own.
travel.transitousTerms: Transitous is a community service for open-source, non-commercial projects. Every request carries your contact so they can reach you if something goes wrong.
travel.googleHelp: Real timetables from Google. You need your own API key: in console.cloud.google.com create a project, turn on billing, enable "Routes API", create an API key restricted to it, and paste it here. Google charges per route with a monthly free allowance.
travel.keySaved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
travel.testRoute: From Plaça de Sants to your first place:
travel.serverHelp: Leave the public Transitous server, or point this at your own MOTIS (for example http://localhost:8080). See the README for how to run one.
ai.title: AI (optional)
ai.help: With your own key, the AI reads the best listings of each search: who lives there, bills, rules, short lets and warning signs. It also drafts messages. Without a key everything still works.
ai.claudeHelp: Create a key at console.anthropic.com → API Keys (pay as you go).
ai.geminiHelp: Create a key at aistudio.google.com → Get API key. It has a free tier.
ai.openaiHelp: Create a key at platform.openai.com → API keys.
ai.openrouterHelp: One key for many models: openrouter.ai → Keys.
ai.ollamaHelp: Free and private. Install Ollama, run "ollama pull" with a model, and write its name here. No key needed.
ai.modelHelp: The list could not be loaded. Write the model name exactly as your provider does.
ai.keySaved: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
ai.aboutMeHelp: Used in message drafts. For example: Ana, 27, nurse at Hospital Clínic, non-smoker, looking from November.
draft.label: Message to the advertiser
describe.label: Describe what you're looking for
describe.placeholder: Room in a flat with other women, up to 650 € with bills, I work at Fira and want to be there by 8:30…
describe.nothing: The AI found nothing to change.
describe.owner: Owner must not live in the flat
describe.notFound: Could not find "{address}" on the map. Add that place by hand.
describe.review: Review the changes below and press Save to keep them.
phone.title: Use it on your phone
phone.qrAlt: QR code to open buscapiso on your phone
phone.steps: On the same Wi-Fi as this computer, open the camera on your phone and point it at the code. Then use "Add to Home Screen" so it opens like an app.
phone.notLan: Your phone can't reach buscapiso yet. Close it and start it again with: buscapiso serve --lan
phone.away: Away from home: install Tailscale on this computer and on your phone, then run "tailscale serve 8770" here. You get a private HTTPS address that also works offline as an app.
phone.revoked: Done. Phones that had the old link must scan the new code.
phone.private: The link includes a private key. Don't share it: anyone with it on your Wi-Fi sees your listings and notes.
auto.title: Automatic searches
auto.help: While buscapiso is open on this computer, it searches on its own. The browser window opens each time.
notify.title: Phone notifications
notify.enable: Send good new rooms to my phone
notify.help: Install the free ntfy app (iOS or Android), tap +, and subscribe to this topic:
notify.private: Anyone who knows the topic name can read it, so it is random. Don't share it.
criteria.changed: Your criteria changed. Re-score the saved rooms to see the effect now, without browsing.
search.last: Last search: {new} new, {accepted} fit, {possible} to ask about
browser.missing: buscapiso searches the portals with its own copy of Chromium, and it isn't installed yet.
browser.failed: The browser could not be installed: {message}
welcome.title: Welcome to buscapiso
welcome.intro: Three steps and you'll have your first list of rooms:
welcome.places: Add the places you go often
welcome.placesHelp: Work, university… Travel time to each one decides which areas are searched.
welcome.searchHelp: A browser window opens and reads the portals for 10 to 15 minutes. Leave it visible.
settings.quitHelp: Stops buscapiso on this computer. Open it again from its icon.
settings.closed: buscapiso is closed. You can close this tab.
